Endurance Training.text: Increases the Health and Armor of your pets by 3%.

Focused Fire.text: Increases all damage you and your pet deal by 1% while your pet is active.

Improved Aspect of the Monkey.text: Increases the Dodge bonus of your Aspect of the Monkey by 2%. Additionally, your pet gains 50% of the effect of your Aspect of the Monkey ability.

Improved Revive Pet.text: Revive Pet's casting time is reduced by 3 sec, mana cost is reduced by 20%, and increases the health your pet returns with by an additional 15%.

Pathfinding.text: Increases the speed bonus of your Aspect of the Cheetah and Aspect of the Pack by 3%.

Bestial Swiftness.text: Increases the movement speed of your pets by 30%.

Unleashed Fury.text: Increases the damage done by your pets and hawks by 3%.

Improved Mend Pet.text: Gives your Mend Pet spell a 15% chance of cleansing 1 Curse, Disease, Magic, or Poison effect from your pet each time it heals and reduces the Mana cost by 10%.

Ferocity.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your pets and hawks by 2%.

Summon Hawk.text: Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing 32 plus 5% of your Ranged Attack Power Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown w

Spirit Bond.text: While your pet is active, you and your pet will regenerate 1% of total health every 10 sec.

Intimidation.text: Command your pet to Stun the target for 3 sec on its next successful attack, which also gains 100% increased critical strike chance. Generates high threat.

Bestial Discipline.text: Increases the Focus regeneration of your pets by 10% and allows 25% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Frenzy.text: Gives your pet a 20% chance to gain a 30% attack speed increase for 8 sec after dealing a critical strike.

Bestial Wrath.text: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.

Hawk Eye.text: Increases the range of your ranged weapons by 2 yards.

Improved Concussive Shot.text: Gives your Concussive Shot a 4% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

Lethal Attacks.text: Increases your critical strike chance with all attacks by 1%.

Improved Stings.text: Increases the damage of your Serpent Sting ability by 6%, reduces the cooldown of your Viper Sting ability by 2 sec, and increases the duration of your Scorpid Sting ability by 15 sec.

Efficiency.text: Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots, Stings, and melee abilities by 3%.

Careful Aim.text: Increases your Attack Power by 20% of your Intellect.

Rapid Killing.text: Reduces the cooldown on your Rapid Fire ability by 1 min. In addition, when you kill a non-trivial enemy or it dies while afflicted by your Serpent Sting, you gain Rapid Killing, increasing the damage of your next Shot a

Improved Arcane Shot.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Arcane Shot by 0.3 sec. Does not affect the cooldown of abilities which share a cooldown with Arcane Shot.

Lone Wolf.text: You deal 20% increased damage with all attacks while you do not have an active pet.

Trueshot Aura.text: Increases the Ranged Attack Power of party or raid members within 45 yds by 15.

Mortal Shots.text: Increases the critical strike damage bonus on all ranged abilities by 6%.

Rapid Recuperation.text: Afflicting a target with Serpent Sting allows 25% of your Mana Regeneration to continue while casting for 15 sec, increased to 50% when Rapid Killing is consumed.

Barrage.text: Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley abilities by 3%.

Scatter Shot.text: A short-range shot that deals 50% weapon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.

Ranged Weapon Specialization.text: Increases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by 1%.

Sniper Shot.text: A long-range shot that deals ranged damage plus 160 and increases the range of your next 3 Shots by 10 yards for 10 sec.

Improved Tracking.text: While tracking Beasts, Demons, Dragonkin, Elementals, Giants, Humanoids, or Undead, all damage you deal to the tracked creature type is increased by 1%.

Entrapment.text: When your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for 1 sec.

Savage Strikes.text: Increases the critical strike chance of all your melee abilities by 2%.

Improved Wing Clip.text: Gives your Wing Clip ability a 7% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

Clever Traps.text: Increases the duration of Freezing and Frost trap effects by 15% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive trap effects by 15%.

Surefooted.text: Increases your hit chance by 1% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by 10%.

Deterrence.text: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

Survival Tactics.text: Increases your chance to hit with your Trap and Feign Death abilities by 5%.

Predator's Edge.text: Increases your melee ability critical strike damage by 6% and your Off Hand weapon damage by 10%.

Counterattack.text: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 13 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

Resourcefulness.text: Reduces the Mana cost of your Trap and melee abilities by 30%, and grants your melee and ranged ability Critical Strikes a 50% chance to allow 50% of your Mana Regeneration to continue while casting for 30 sec.

Expose Prey.text: Grants your melee and ranged attacks against enemies afflicted by Hunter's Mark a 5% chance to allow an activation of Mongoose Bite. Lasts 10 sec.

Survivalist's Discipline.text: Reduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by 20%.

Strider Kick.text: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec.

Lacerating Strikes.text: Your Mongoose Bite also causes the target to Bleed for damage equal to 40% of the damage done by Mongoose Bite over 21 sec
